How much does it cost to run a slow cooker?

A typical slow cooker uses about 200 watts (150–300W depending on the model). Used for 8 hours per use, 2 uses a week, it costs about 29p per use and £30.66 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
29p
About £30.66 a year at 8 hours per use, 2 uses a week.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Use the smallest appliance that does the job: a microwave or air fryer usually beats the oven for small portions.
  • Turn things off at the wall if they sit on standby all day.
  • Check the energy label when you replace an appliance; running costs over its life often outweigh the price difference.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a slow cooker per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 200W model costs about 3.7p an hour, allowing for it running at full power about 70% of the time.

How much does it cost to run a slow cooker per year?

About £30.66 a year, based on 8 hours per use, 2 uses a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my slow cooker's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
